readme_label_correction: The published benchmark script and retained image use 73 and 191 residues, not the README labels of 35 and 152.
model_settings: Original upstream preset defaults (TF32; no extra acceleration flags); relaxation toggled as in the README.
solo_embeddings: All inference conditions use original run1 embeddings; embedding generation is timed and compared separately for each runtime.
downloads: No runtime downloads, live MSA searches, private data or large alignment databases.
gpu_execution: Sequential conditions, no overlapping builds or other GPU work; no deletion during qualification.
